text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan, Daiwa Scarlet, and Vodka 
were all defeated... Yet the audience 
seemed satisfied just witnessing a 
showdown between the Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The intense race was burned into Aston 
Machan's mind, making her feel blessed 
with great rivals. She then turned her 
thoughts to her next clash with the two.
